def main():

    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    s = data[2:]
    
    # Create a list of tuples (index, book_title)
    indexed_books = list(enumerate(s, start=1))
    
    # Sort the books based on the asc-desc-ending criteria
    indexed_books.sort(key=lambda x: [(ord(c) if j % 2 == 0 else -ord(c)) for j, c in enumerate(x[1])])
    
    # Extract the sorted indices
    sorted_indices = [idx for idx, _ in indexed_books]
    
    # Print the sorted indices
    print(" ".join(map(str, sorted_indices)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
